name: describe_device
description: Describe one network device and dynamically enumerate every vanilla logic type it reports as readable or writable. A device in a rocket also gets rocket {network_id, name, state, dry_mass_kg, hull_pieces, internals} (1.6.0+); a rocket umbilical (gas, power, chute, crew; male or socket) gets umbilical {role, open, partner, partner_distance, search}: the partner the game holds and the game's partner search replayed now (found, partner_distance, how, and per column why it stopped: a device between, a non-matching umbilical, one not facing back). A Logic Rocket Uplink gets uplink (1.14.0+) {downlink ({reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, rocket} of the Logic Rocket Downlink it follows, rocket as above or null; null when it follows none), connected (its data connection is live: on, powered, built, and the downlink on a data network), choices (every downlink it may follow, as a screwdriver press steps through them: built and logic readable)}; set_uplink changes it. Mod logic types without an enum name are read and written by numeric id (1.14.0+: this note is no longer repeated in every reply).

reference_id.description: Target device reference ID returned by list_devices.
